'''Esseles starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. The [[LE-series repair droid|repair droid]] [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|LE-BO2D9]] originally served the spaceport's [[Esseles starport portmaster|portmaster]], ensuring [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] were meeting [[Starship/Legends|starship]] safety regulations, but was ferried away during one inspection when a [[Unidentified freighter captain (Esseles)|freighter captain]] blasted off with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] aboard.
